title: ERTransformer-generated TCR candidates activate T cells in defined receptor contexts
summary: ERTransformer generated epitope-conditioned TCR β-chain CDR3 candidates. Flow-cytometry experiments found selected artificial TCRs induced activation comparable to or greater than natural controls in defined TCR/pMHC contexts. This represents the September 2026 journal report; an ERTransformer precursor was posted October 20, 2023. The earlier report does not establish that these journal wet-lab results were already public.
organization: Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab; City University of Hong Kong; The University of Hong Kong; Xijing Hospital of Digestive Diseases; Harvard Medical School, Harvard University; Monash University

evidence.tested: Selected generated candidates tested for T-cell activation by flow cytometry.
evidence.unknown: Full experimental methods and supplements not assessed: publisher rendering exposed abstract and metadata. General specificity, safety and clinical outcomes are not established by this review.
evidence.ai_role: Generates TCR β-chain CDR3 candidates conditioned on epitopes.
